scope: ESB-referendum opinion/adsent pieces, May 1 - Aug 17 2026, excluding visir.is

mbl.is.notes: Free news search endpoint (form param qs, paginate offset=0,20,40...; needs browser UA, WebFetch gets 403). Monthly ESB adsend-grein counts: May 5, Jun 14, Jul 17, Aug 19 (to Aug 17). Slugs prefixed adsend_grein_. FULL TEXT PAYWALLED (Morgunbladid login) - only title + meta-description lede retrievable. greinasafn (print archive) also subscription-only. RSS/teaser scraping gives headline+author+first sentence only.

dv.is/eyjan.notes: No paywall. curl needs browser UA and -L (301 on trailing slash). Crawled pages 0-30: 412 eyjan articles Apr-Aug; strict slug-keyword ESB filter = 54 (May-Aug), but keyword filter caught only 7/13 already-captured URLs, so true count ~70-90. Mix of adsendar greinar, fastir pennar (Thorsteinn Palsson, Sigmundur Ernir, Bjorn Jon), and interview/quote pieces (Gauti B. Eggertsson series, Albert Jonsson, Halla Hrund). Biggest uncaptured venue.

heimildin.is.notes: label=20 = Adsent listing, newest first, ~20/page, 58 pages (page 1 covers Jul 12-Aug 17: 4 ESB; page 2 May 5-Jul 4: 3 ESB incl. 2 already captured). NOTE /adsent/ path is a stale 2017-2023 legacy archive - use ?label=20. Article text partially paywalled (subscription prompt mid-article). Separate staff-journalism series 'Horft til Evropu' (~36 articles) at /greinarod/horft-til-evropu/ - reporting/analysis, not adsent opinion.

vb.is.notes: 403 to WebFetch; curl with browser UA works. /skodun/ front page lists ~57 recent columns; ~12-15 ESB-related (e.g. hvers-vegna-er-hagsmunum-islands-betur-borgid-utan-evropusambandsins, island-og-vegferd-esb, kemur-evropusambandid-til-bjargar, gongum-i-esb-og-faum-odyrt-stoff2, nedanmals-odysseifur-eda-esb, haegfara-daudi-evropu2, stor-ja-en-hversu-stor, sannfaerandi-malflutningur-ja-lida, folkid-sem-segir-ja-til-ad-sja..., spurningar-sem-kalla-a-svor-fyrir-agustlok2). Named columns (Odinn/Tyr/Huginn og muninn) are subscriber-only; tested article showed ~5 free paragraphs.

ruv.is.notes: RUV carries no adsendar greinar / opinion section (public broadcaster). ESB coverage is news, polls, explainers only. Nothing to capture in the opinion category.

frettin.is.notes: NOT in dataset at all. Right-wing/anti-ESB outlet, WordPress, free. 403 to WebFetch; curl with browser UA works. ~5-6 ESB commentary pieces in the last 10 days alone (e.g. 2026/08/14 Carl Baudenbacher adsent piece, 2026/08/15 ja-skuldbindingin-og-ees-haettan, 2026/08/04 pawel-og-neitunarvaldid). Estimate 20-40 over May-Aug; search matches are noisy (426 result pages sitewide), filter by 2026/0[5-8] date slugs.

samstodin.is.notes: Left outlet (aligned with 'Til vinstri vid ESB' angle). Mostly video clips/shows; few written opinion pieces (/opinion/ path, e.g. malefnalegt-samtal-thjodarinnar-um-esb-adild). Low volume, low priority.

kjarninn.is.notes: Merged into Heimildin in 2023; no longer publishes.
